svg.title: Conflict triage framework: from question to response type
svg.desc: A flowchart showing how to classify a conflict into one of four categories — mountain, tangled rope, fragile consensus, or genuine sheaf — and what to do in each case.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about genuine sheaf conflicts — where all observers agree')
g.text: Use conflict resolution — it works here

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about fragile consensus — apparent agreement that hides latent disagreement')
g.text: Monitor; identify what would break it
vary scope, exit quality, time horizon

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about tangled rope conflicts — disagreements that change with scope or exit conditions')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about mountain conflicts — structurally irreducible disagreements')
g.text: Manage, don't resolve; name it honestly

svg.text: Mountain test: is disagreement Nash-stable? (no unilateral reclassification resolves it)
Fragile test: would a parameter shift create open disagreement from apparent consensus?
